candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement 'pot = 0;' after the winning transfer, so the pot is not reset.
Change 'pot += msg.value;' to 'pot += 1;' so the pot grows by 1 instead of the ticket amount.
Change 'payable(msg.sender).transfer(pot - FEE_AMOUNT);' to 'payable(msg.sender).transfer(pot);' so the winner receives the whole pot including the fee.
Change 'payable(bank).transfer(FEE_AMOUNT);' to 'payable(bank).transfer(0);' so no fee is sent to the bank, altering the pot state after reset.
Change 'require(msg.value == TICKET_AMOUNT);' to 'require(msg.value == 0);' making the play function callable with zero ether, which changes the pot increment behavior.
Replace `pot += msg.value;` with `pot += msg.value - FEE_AMOUNT;` so that the pot tracked is reduced by the fee, changing the winner payout.
Replace `payable(bank).transfer(FEE_AMOUNT);` with `payable(msg.sender).transfer(FEE_AMOUNT);` so that the fee goes to the winner instead of the bank.
Replace `payable(msg.sender).transfer(pot - FEE_AMOUNT);` with `payable(bank).transfer(pot - FEE_AMOUNT);` so that the pot (minus fee) is paid to the bank instead of the player.
Delete `pot = 0;` so that the pot is never reset after a win, allowing subsequent wins to drain a growing pot balance.
Replace `if (random == 0)` with `if (random != 0)` so that the win condition is inverted.
Replace `require(msg.value == TICKET_AMOUNT);` with `require(msg.value >= TICKET_AMOUNT);` so that users can overpay, thus changing the pot accumulation and payouts.
Insert `pot += msg.value;` a second time so that the pot is double-counted per play, increasing the winner's payout.
